# Control ModernDataGridColumn
Part of the control family React.

Control creation keywords:
```yaml
Control: ModernDataGridColumn
Variant: <variant name> # (required) see below for the list of variants
```

The `Variant` keyword is required and must be one of the following:
- `Boolean`
- `Button`
- `ComplexOptionSet`
- `ComplexType`
- `Currency`
- `DateTime`
- `Email`
- `Image`
- `Number`
- `Phone`
- `Textual`
- `Url`

Input Properties:
  - ContentLanguage: Text
      Default: ""
  - FieldDisplayName: Text
  - FieldName: Text
  - FieldVariantName: Text
  - Visible: Boolean
      Default: true
  - Width: Number
      Default: 150

Additional input properties for variant `Boolean`:
  - DisplayType: Enum
      Default: BooleanDisplay.Text
      Enum name: BooleanDisplay
      Enum values: Checkbox, Text, Toggle
  - Icon: Text
      Default: ""
  - Text: Text
  - Value: Boolean

Additional input properties for variant `Button`:
  - AccessibleLabel: Text
      Default: ""
  - Appearance: Enum
      Default: ButtonAppearance.Primary
      Enum name: ButtonAppearance
      Enum values: Outline, Primary, Secondary, Subtle, Transparent
  - Icon: Text
      Default: ""
  - OnSelect: Boolean
      Default: false
  - Text: Text
  - Wrap: Boolean
      Default: false

Additional input properties for variant `ComplexOptionSet`:
  - Icon: Text
      Default: ""
  - Text: Text

Additional input properties for variant `ComplexType`:
  - Icon: Text
      Default: ""
  - Text: Text

Additional input properties for variant `Currency`:
  - Icon: Text
      Default: ""
  - Text: Text

Additional input properties for variant `DateTime`:
  - Icon: Text
      Default: ""
  - Text: Text

Additional input properties for variant `Email`:
  - Icon: Text
      Default: ""
  - Text: Text

Additional input properties for variant `Image`:
  - AccessibleLabel: Text
      Default: ""
  - Image: Image

Additional input properties for variant `Number`:
  - Icon: Text
      Default: ""
  - Value: Number

Additional input properties for variant `Phone`:
  - Icon: Text
      Default: ""
  - Text: Text

Additional input properties for variant `Textual`:
  - Icon: Text
      Default: ""
  - Text: Text
  - Wrap: Boolean
      Default: false

Additional input properties for variant `Url`:
  - Icon: Text
      Default: ""
  - Text: Text
  - URL: Text

Additional input properties if a child of a Vertical or Horizontal GroupContainer:
  - AlignInContainer: Enum
      Default: AlignInContainer.SetByContainer
      Enum name: AlignInContainer
      Enum values: Center, End, SetByContainer, Start, Stretch
  - FillPortions: Number
      Default: 0
  - LayoutMaxHeight: Number
      Default: 0
  - LayoutMaxWidth: Number
      Default: 0
  - LayoutMinHeight: Number
      Default: Parent.Height
  - LayoutMinWidth: Number
      Default: 150

Additional input properties if a child of a Grid GroupContainer:
  - LayoutGridColumnEnd: Number
  - LayoutGridColumnStart: Number
  - LayoutGridRowEnd: Number
  - LayoutGridRowStart: Number

Output Properties:
  - ContentLanguage: Text
  - FieldDisplayName: Text
  - Visible: Boolean
  - Width: Number
